factory_acceptance_questions.question: Confirm the order form lets JLC04081H-3313 be chosen for this 4-layer 0.8 mm order without impedance-controlled traces, and that the fabricated build follows it.
Which core and copper construction JLC uses for a 2-layer 0.8 mm FR-4 board (needed for the optical/translucency assumption, not for orderability).

Whether JLC CAM/DFM accepts the large mask openings that expose ENIG copper around pads, and confirmation that no trace is left uncovered (else the 0.25/0.25 mm uncovered-trace rule applies). Not checked against the Gerbers by this review.

Whether the custom openings and local dams are kept as drawn (for the 2-layer leaf, the "Do not modify original solder mask size" option; for the 4-layer controller, 1:1 LDI), and whether a 0.10 mm web between a tented via and an opening is held (the published 0.10 mm row is pad spacing, not a tented-via rule).
Whether tenting holds over the 0.10 mm web to the nearest opening on 0.8 mm boards; thin mask on the annular ring is a stated normal appearance.
Thin-board acceptance: whether 0.8 mm customer panels of this size need extra support, a carrier or wider rails, and whether double-sided reflow of the 0.8 mm controller is accepted as is.
PCBA quantity unit for a customer panel (panels or boards) and acceptance of these panels; the owner closed this from their own knowledge (jlc-questions, owner-stated, not supplier-confirmed).
